conflicts_resolved: Two trips: planner_couple (primary) wants the page to say the notary route is the realistic one for overseas couples. The source pack supports only that the Registro Civil request is lodged together in person and that the procedure averages 4 to 6 months; no notary timeline is sourced. So the fix states those facts plainly and points to the notary as the other legal route, with no claim that either route is better.

Reassurance after safety: funding_parent and planner_couple want a calming line (transfers, someone on the ground). Wedded Wonderland transfers and on-the-ground support are not in brand facts, so they are deferred; the fix is calmer ordering of Smartraveller's exact words, ending with questions to ask the resort.

Region and month steer: planner_couple (primary) and funding_parent want regions compared and good months named. No tourism or IMN facts are sourced and Smartraveller seasons are the only season facts, so nothing is added; deferred until sourced.
Fee amounts: sceptic, funding_parent, planner_couple and search_visitor want La Gaceta, notary, translation and apostille figures. The no-amounts rule wins; deferred.

Wedded Wonderland business details (fees, commissions, who is on the ground, scale proof, real weddings, perks, Wedded Privileges, transfers, paperwork help, private introductions) raised by all five are deferred, not added.
Non-Australian readers: uhnw and search_visitor want broader framing. The brief's reader is an Australian couple, so excluded.

Security item: uhnw values the private-security and drone questions; planner_couple (primary), funding_parent and search_visitor feel excluded by them. Primary persona wins on framing, so the item is reworded for everyone rather than cut, which keeps it useful for uhnw.
